title: lapanda: A Matrix-Free Differentiable Solver for Nonconvex Constrained Optimization Layers
summary: Differentiable optimization brings the structural guarantees of mathematical optimization to network pipelines, allowing them to be trained end-to-end. However, its application remains challenging for nonconvex constrained problems, as existing differentiable solvers often suffer from limited modeling expressiveness due to their reliance on specialized problem structures, while also incurring substantial computation time and memory overhead in both the forward and backward passes.
